task: V5 remainder — tree-canopy sway (fire-flicker already shipped)
pattern: Self-attaching [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)], hidden DontDestroyOnLoad GO, FindFirstObjectByType idempotency guard — mirrors FlickerLight/RainSoundDriver/NightLightPoolDriver

approach.sprite_child: Creates 'TreeSway' child GO per tree at runtime with mirrored SpriteRenderer (same sprite/sortingLayerID/sortingOrder as root). Root SR set enabled=false (tint anchor, draw-disabled). Child SR draws the canopy and is swayed.
approach.sway: +/-0.04 world units (~0.64 px at PPU16, within spec ±1 px) horizontal sine at 0.3 Hz on child localPosition.x ONLY. Root transform never touched.
approach.phase: Deterministic per-tree phase offset derived from GO instanceID & 0xFF — 45 trees get distributed phases; no lock-step sway.
approach.easing: liveAmplitude eases from 0 → target via exp lerp (EaseLerpSpeed=2.0) on first attach — no position pop.
approach.tint_mirror: Root SR color (written by TakeChopDamage / TintHelper / SetSpecies) mirrored to child SR each frame so chop-tint and species-tint remain visible.
approach.rescan: Periodic poll every 2.0s (Time.unscaledTime) picks up trees regrown by RegrowthScheduler. Dead-tree entries pruned each scan + each Update.

qa_flags: TreeSway child GOs are children of TreeEntity GOs; Destroy(tree.gameObject) cascades — confirm no orphan 'TreeSway' GOs after a chop.
Root SpriteRenderer.enabled=false; confirm species-tint (SetSpecies) and chop-damage tint (TakeChopDamage/TintHelper) are still visible via per-frame color mirror in TreeSwayEntry.Update.
Scene-wiring: zero SceneSetup edits; confirm no double-attach on scene reload (FindFirstObjectByType guard).
Binary acceptance: tree canopy shows <=1px lateral drift between frames ~1s apart; tree does NOT drift off its cell (root untouched); nothing else jitters; sway recedes (does not out-move pawns).

acceptance.visual_sway: Canopy shows <=1px lateral drift between two frames ~1s apart
acceptance.root_intact: Tree does NOT drift off its cell (root transform.position untouched)
